evals.prompt: I have customer data in PostgreSQL and order data in S3 parquet files. I need to join them in one SQL query. How do I set this up in Spice?
evals.expected_output: Configure both datasets in spicepod.yaml with their respective connectors, then write a federated JOIN query

assertions.name: shows_join_query
assertions.description: Should show a federated JOIN SQL query

evals.prompt: I want to create a view that pre-aggregates my sales data by day so my dashboards are faster. Can Spice do that?
evals.expected_output: Yes, configure a view in spicepod.yaml with SQL aggregation, optionally accelerate the view

assertions.name: shows_view_config
assertions.description: Should show the views section in YAML config

assertions.name: shows_sql_aggregation
assertions.description: Should include SQL aggregation in the view definition

evals.prompt: We use Unity Catalog at our company. Can I connect Spice to it so I can query our existing tables without manually defining each dataset?
evals.expected_output: Configure a catalog with from: unity_catalog, provide endpoint and token, use include patterns to filter schemas
